prose: The New York Times reports that the AI data-center boom is lifting paint maker PPG: its specialized gray coatings resist fire, rust, and static electricity on data-center exteriors, and JLL estimates the coatings run $3-8 million per data center. Tech companies are painting facilities gray over gray concrete and steel, turning an unlikely supplier into an AI-boom beneficiary.
highlights: The AI build-out is boosting PPG's sales of specialized gray data-center coatings (NYT)
The coatings serve fire, rust, and static-electricity resistance needs
JLL estimates $3-8M of coatings per data center
Data centers are painted gray over gray concrete and steel
